response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS overall_avg FROM budget), by_status AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_left_over FROM budget GROUP BY event_status) SELECT by_status.event_status, by_status.avg_left_over, by_status.avg_left_over - overall.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM by_status CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
